title: Reader typography: Dynamic Type base with the slider as a relative offset
roadmap_anchor: Q2 > Accessibility > Dynamic Type as the base
acceptance: The reader's size slider becomes a relative offset via UIFontMetrics or Font.custom(size:relativeTo:), not an absolute size
The reader opens at a readable size on Accessibility XL before the slider is touched
Stored reading preferences keep working; an existing offset is not silently reinterpreted as a new absolute size
notes: Split from T-0012. This is the half that genuinely touches the reader text stack and the persisted ReadingPreferences offset — it is where the migration risk lives, and it is small and focused instead of buried in 77 chrome edits.
